answers.why: Israel's survivors are those remaining in Zion and Jerusalem.
The men of Judah are addressed alongside the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
The men of Judah are God's planting alongside the house of Israel.
The Holy One of Israel is the God whose counsel the sinful people challenge.
The people despise the Holy One of Israel's word, provoking anger against his people.
Ephraim is the kingdom allied with Syria against Jerusalem.
Ephraim joins Syria and Remaliah's son in plotting against Ahaz.
Judah is the kingdom they plan to invade and place a king over.
Ephraim will be broken so that it ceases to be a people.
Samaria is named as Ephraim's capital under Remaliah's son.
Ephraim's departure from Judah refers to the division of the kingdoms.
Judah is the kingdom from which Ephraim separated.
